notes.title: Christmas Holiday Update
notes.content:
Hello Guys,

We've created some Christmas feeling and decoration for all the levels available in the game. The content will be accessible until 12th January 2025. We hope you will enjoy puzzling in a cosy Christmas room. 

There are 9 new Christmas-themed puzzle images as well.

Merry Christmas for everyone!

notes.title: You LOVE puzzling
notes.content:
Dear Jigs4w3D Fam,

it's been a thrilling 5 days since we released Jigs4w3D Puzzle Challenge.
Browsing Steam's deeply sophisticated statistics, we came to a conclusion, that ...

... you LOVE puzzling ... a lot ːB1ː

[h3]Statistics[/h3]

We have behind us many short nights, a major and three minor patches, a ton of replies and many-many smiles.

Your results in the past 5 days
[list]
[*]25,075 copies were added to Your Steam libraries
[*]5,397 of You tried the game already
[*]we had 325 daily active puzzlers
[*]your [b]median[/b] playtime ([i]based on 5,397 players[/i]) is [b]7 hours 59 minutes[/b] - this is insane - you really do love puzzling.
[/list]
We appreciate all of you who tried the game, supported us via [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/3026980/Jigs4w3D_Puzzle_Challenge/]purchasing our DLCs[/url], or gave us a feedback.

We do not stop here, many free updates, puzzle packs, environments and features are coming, so stay tuned! We would like to make puzzling fun, so we are working on a couple of predictable, and also some never-seen puzzle features. So, let ... us ... cook ːcleanhourglassː

[h3]Reviews[/h3]

Despite all of these great stats, the number of reviews we have is something we definitely would like to improve. If you really like our game - as the stats show to us -, please take a minute to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3026980/Jigs4w3D_Puzzle_Challenge]write a review for Jigs4w3D[/url].

We're continuously looking forward to receive your feedbacks, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3026980/discussions/0/6579276631062565156/]let us know[/url] what features or improvements you'd like to see in Jigs4w3D!

Stay Awesome,
ːEdgarː

notes.title: Jigs4w3D v1.1 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[list]
[*][h3]Added a new feature - Auto arrange[/h3][expand type=details]Use the Auto arrange button from the Game menu to respawn all unplaced puzzle pieces into a more organized formation[/expand]
[*][h3]Added 'Rotate puzzle pieces' and 'Zoom' features to keyboard shortcuts 'X' and 'C'[/h3][expand type=details]
Use keyboard button 'X' to
- rotate a grabbed puzzle piece (counterclockwise) by 15 degrees (off-board), or by 90 degrees (on-board)
- zoom in

Use keyboard button 'C' to
- rotate a grabbed puzzle piece (clockwise) by 15 degrees (off-board), or by 90 degrees (on-board)
- zoom out

[i]Note: Rotation using mouse wheel remained intact.[/i]
[/expand]
[*]Added a new image category - Flowers
[*]Added 11 new puzzles for the 'Free to play' version[expand type=details]
Cats - Oh no! Water!, Sleeping
Dogs - Tired
Landscapes - Savannah, Sunrise
Cars - Red car in fire, Red wonder
Abstract - Blue pear, Orange
Flowers - Roses, Tulip fields
[/expand]
[*]Fixed a case where completion icons for puzzles that don't have achievements haven't appeared after completion
[*]Improved lights in the 'Living room' environment
[*]Improved spawn mechanism
[*]Various physics optimizations
[*]Minor tweaks and bugfixes
[/list]

Don't forget to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3026980/discussions/0/6579276631062565156/]let us know[/url] what features or improvements you'd like to see in Jigs4w3D!

notes.title: 10K copies and counting
notes.content:
Hi Jigs4w3D Fam,

we are thrilled to announce that we've just reached our first major milestone.

[h3]10.000 Jigs4w3D copies were added to Your Steam libraries[/h3]

As a small, but very passionate Team at WOMBEX Games, this means a lot to us.
It happened so fast, we almost missed it! ːB1ː

Thanks for your continuous support, we greatly appreciate every bit of a help, share, like, comment and alike; along with the also great and rising median playtime stat as well, naturally ;)
The high median playtime and a lot of positive reviews are definitely indicate that you really like it.

We're continuously looking forward to receive your feedbacks, please [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3026980/discussions/0/6579276631062565156/]let us know[/url] what features or improvements you'd like to see in Jigs4w3D!

Stay Awesome,
ːEdgarː
